login.title: Log in with Discord
login.text: No password, no email. You only see the servers you can manage.

configure.title: Make it yours
configure.text: Modules, channels, roles, panels — the bot picks it up within seconds.

permitted.title: Authorised users only
permitted.text: You need the Administrator or Manage Server permission, and the bot must be on the server too — checked again on every request.

token.title: No stored tokens
token.text: HttpOnly, Secure cookie. The Discord token never reaches the browser, and we never write it to a database.

input.title: Validated input
input.text: Every field goes through a schema; channels and roles are checked against the server’s real data.

audit.title: Everything is logged
audit.text: Every change shows up in the server’s log: who, what, when.

price.a: Nothing. Both the bot and the dashboard are free.

scopes.q: What permissions does logging in ask for?
scopes.a: Only your name and your list of servers (Discord “identify” and “guilds”). We can’t see your email address or messages, and we never do anything on Discord in your name.

who.a: Anyone with the Administrator or Manage Server permission on Discord, on a server where the bot is present. The bot’s own levels (Staff, Moderator, Admin) are set on the Roles and permissions page.

delay.q: How long until the bot picks up a change?
delay.a: A few seconds. The bot reloads settings within 15 seconds and posts panels within 5 seconds.

commands.q: Do I need to learn commands?
commands.a: No. Every setting is on the web; members see what they can use in /help.

language.q: Which language does the bot speak?
language.a: The bot speaks Hungarian, English or German — set it per server on the dashboard (Basics → Language), and every reply uses that language. The dashboard is available in Hungarian, English and German — choose your language in the menu.
